subject.title: fix(text): harden string helpers against small/degenerate inputs

question: Should requester grouping intentionally collapse every trailing `[bot]` suffix while mutation authorization continues to require an exact trusted actor identity?
rationale: The implementation preserves the existing fail-closed authorization check, but the intended identity semantics for non-authorizing requester grouping are a security-sensitive product boundary that tests alone cannot choose.

options.title: Approve grouped normalization
options.body: Accept repeated-suffix collapsing for requester grouping because authorization continues to compare the raw submitted actor exactly.

options.title: Preserve single-suffix grouping
options.body: Keep the existing one-suffix requester normalization if malformed identities must remain distinct outside authorization as well.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped normalization
recommendation.body: Accept repeated-suffix collapsing for requester grouping because authorization continues to compare the raw submitted actor exactly.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly requested deliberate review of this exact grouping and authorization boundary.
